newsitem.title: USA: Ill. May unemployment down in all 10 metro areas.
newsitem.headline: Ill. May unemployment down in all 10 metro areas.

text.p: The unemployment rate dropped in all 10 Illinois metropolitan areas in May compared to April, with each recording substantial drops from one year ago, the Illinois Department of Employment Security reported Thursday.

"Sustained job growth, a significantly lower number of unemployment insurance claims and increased manufacturing hours worked over the year, completed the state's healthy employment picture," department Director Lynn Doherty said in a statement.
The unadjusted rates ranged from 2.3 percent in Bloomington-Normal to 6.6 percent in Decatur, with Chicago posting a 4.2 percent rate, the department reported.

Nine of the 10 areas also posted gains in payroll jobs compared to one year ago on the strength of growth in the services, manufacturing, trade and finance-insurance-real estate sectors, the department reported.
